honest_minimal_path.concept: An explicit approximate final predictor; candidate could anchor at the complete portablev82 and fit its residual tov80 using fixed recoverable prediction differences. This is a prospective design choice, not a frozen experiment.
honest_minimal_path.CV: Within each Jan/Jul outer month, complete fixed day blocks are excluded from student fit. All teacher and input-basis models must exclude that entire outer month; teacher labels are outputs only. Decode taxi labels only after every student prediction is persisted.
honest_minimal_path.production: Fit same frozen mapping on original2026 ranking teacher outputs and audited old-view predictor basis, then apply to four-month final predictor basis. No exact-v80 claim; no new public correction layer after fitting fullteacher unless separately declared.
honest_minimal_path.required_controls: Exactv80/v82 saved-vector replay; zero student correction exactlyv82; actual serialized student taxiCV versusv82, both months and predeclared paired uncertainty. Teacher fidelity is secondary only.
honest_minimal_path.data_scope: No row IDs, dates or original teacher lookup as predictive inputs; fixed global coefficients, full-row output and template-ID audits; no coefficient/penalty/blend search.
honest_minimal_path.alias_scope: Whole days must handle boundary aliases conservatively or prove none; chronological blocks reduce same-source cohort dependence.

limitations: Within-month blocks test same-month conditional approximation, not2026Jan/Jul to newFeb/June transfer.
Cross-month CV cannot naively train on July teacher while scoringJanuary: July teacher base models includeJanuary labels. A common outer-safe teacher on both sides is required.
AllJan/Jul development remains reused; absence of direct student truth fitting is not independent confirmation.
Restricted official-score affine solve already minimizes old-label MSE in its declared span/objective; a closer teacher projection need not improve taxi accuracy.
Final clocks are shifted; distillation uses final model inputs normally and must not be presented as exact teacher transport.
Best plausible role is improving the admissible portable final, not evidence of reaching205.
